title: causonis maritima
intro: Causonis maritima, commonly known as Sea Holly, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health, thanks to its health benefits of aiding in the relief of symptoms associated with various gastrointestinal issues and its ability to combat oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Causonis maritima include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as arthritis and ulcers. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
